title: Lakefront Landing Marina

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Ossipee Lake with its 3 bays - Broad Bay, Leavitt Bay and Berry Bay - is a boaters dream. The lake and connecting bays contain many sand bars to anchor your boat on and one even has a volley ball net for a game or two!! Our well maintained fleet includes boats to fit your needs-from fishing, skiing or tubing to family cruising. We also provide DELIVERY to use our boats at other New Hampshire lakes. Call for price quotes and availability.We require a $100.00 PER DAY NON-REFUNDABLE DEPOSIT NO EXCEPTIONS! 20ft Blue Sweetwater Pontoon ***** 25hp EFI 4 stroke Mercury O/B. 10 person

blurb: On Ossipee Lake ... Lakefront Landing is the place to be. Located on Ossipee Lake in Eastern New Hampshire. It's one of the largest lakes located entirely in New Hampshire. The seventh largest lake in the state is 3,092-acre Ossipee Lake and its extensive network of rivers and bays.
